turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on he, she and it with -s?
turns.tutor:
Here is one example. I walk to work. She walks to work. Step 1: who? "She". Step 2: add -s to "walk".
With he, she or it, the verb gets -s or -es.
Right: He cooks every day. Wrong: He cook every day.
Your turn. Write only the verb:
Write the correct form: My sister ___ (play) tennis on Sundays. (answer with only the verb)
